chunks: about the tawaf: can a man suffice with the counting of his companion?

key_terms.الرَّجُلُ: the man, meaning the person performing tawaf
key_terms.الْأَعْرَجُ: al-A'raj, the identifier of the narrator Sa'id
key_terms.سَعِيدٌ: Sa'id, the named questioner in the report
key_terms.يَكْتَفِي: to suffice or be content with relying on something

ai.seo_question: Can a person rely on someone else's counting during tawaf?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning tawaf, stating that a person may rely on his companion's counting of the circuits. It reflects practical facilitation in the performance of this act of worship.
